S5_algebra.fixtureMatches: gamma^a, C, chirality rebuilt from CONTRACT section 1 equal the committed fixture
S5_algebra.gamma8Properties: gamma^8 = gamma^0...gamma^7 = diag(-I8, +I8): Hermitian, square 1, anticommutes with every gamma^a, commutes with C and with all 28 S^{bc} (hence with Omega_mu for every connection)
S5_algebra.CProperties: C real symmetric, C^2 = 1; C gamma^a real antisymmetric (anti-Hermitian), a = 0..7
S5_algebra.BProperties: B = -i C gamma^4 = -i gamma^0..gamma^4: Hermitian, B^2 = 1, Tr B = 0 (spectrum (+1)^8 (-1)^8), [B, C] = 0, BC = -i gamma^4, gamma^8 B gamma^8 = -B
S5_algebra.gamma8InIdentityComponent: gamma^8 = (g0 g1)(g2 g3)(g4 g5)(g6 g7), four commuting bivectors with X^2 = -1, so gamma^8 = exp((pi/2)(X1 + X2 + X3 + X4)) lies in Spin_0(4,4); its vector action is -1 (in SO_0(4,4))
S5_algebra.gammaDaggerC: gamma^a dagger C = -C gamma^a for a = 0..7

bilinearParities.statement: gamma^8 X gamma^8 = -X for X in {C gamma^a, C gamma^a S^{bc}, C S^{bc} gamma^a} (8 + 224 + 224 = 456) and gamma^8 C gamma^8 = +C

S5_algebra.chiralBlockStructure: C and every S^{bc} are block diagonal in (Psi_0..Psi_7 | Psi_8..Psi_15), every gamma^a is block off-diagonal: gamma^8 Psi = (-Psi_upper, +Psi_lower)

characterIsMinusNorm.statement: u^dagger C = chi(u) C u^{-1} with chi(u) = -n(u) for every real unit vector

kreinUnderBasicReflections.derivation: B = -i gamma^0 gamma^1 gamma^2 gamma^3 gamma^4: gamma^a (a <= 4) commutes with the 5-fold product, gamma^5..gamma^7 anticommute; with gamma^a dagger = eta_aa gamma^a this gives +B, +B, +B, +B, +B, -B, -B, -B (not the Pin character: B is tied to the x4 foliation)

nontrivial.note: the connection enters L through Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi / 2 (non-trivial coupling to the spin connection and, through e_a^mu and sqrt|g|, to gravity)

S5_T1generic.scalarInvariantKineticOdd: S[gamma^8 Psi] = S[Psi], K[gamma^8 Psi] = -K[Psi], U even
S5_T1generic.naiveFixedLambdaFails: L_{m,lam}[gamma^8 Psi] + L_{-m,lam}[Psi] = -lam sqrt|g| S^2 != 0 (CONTRACT erratum E2)
S5_T1generic.fieldEquation: E_{-m,-lam}[gamma^8 Psi] = -gamma^8 E_{m,lam}[Psi] (16 components, with the cubic term)

eulerLagrangeFromLagrangian.statement: gamma^8 EL^{(m,lam)}[gamma^8 Psi] = -EL^{(-m,-lam)}[Psi] for the Euler-Lagrange expressions dL/dPsi^* - d_mu dL/d(d_mu Psi^*) derived from L (total derivative acting on the geometric coefficients too); hence Psi solves EL_{m,lam} iff gamma^8 Psi solves EL_{-m,-lam}

emtAll36.statement: T_{mu nu}[gamma^8 Psi; -m, -lam] = -T_{mu nu}[Psi; m, lam]
emtAll36.method: T = K_{mu nu} + g_{mu nu} L_s with g_{mu nu} an independent symbol: the identity holds iff it holds for K_{mu nu} (each component) and for L_s; T_44 also assembled in full

S5_T1generic.connectionCommutesWithGamma8: [gamma^8, gamma^b gamma^c] = 0 for all 28 pairs: [gamma^8, Omega_mu] = 0 for every connection

nontrivial.note: the quartic self-interaction S^2 is a nonzero degree-4 element (120 monomials; squares of odd generators vanish, unlike the commuting 136)

S5_T1grassmann.scalarEvenKineticOdd: S -> S, K -> -K, S^2 -> S^2 under theta -> chi theta
S5_T1grassmann.lagrangian: L_{m,lam}[gamma^8 Psi] = -L_{-m,-lam}[Psi] in the Grassmann algebra (all m, lam: K odd, S and S^2 even)
S5_T1grassmann.diracOperator: E_{-m,-lam}[gamma^8 Psi] = -gamma^8 E_{m,lam}[Psi] with the cubic term lam S Psi (odd, degree 3)

emt.statement: T_{mu nu}[gamma^8 Psi; -m, -lam] = -T_{mu nu}[Psi; m, lam] (Grassmann-even elements)

eulerLagrangeFromLagrangian.statement: left-derivative Euler-Lagrange expressions of sqrt|g| L_{m,lam} (constant coefficients): gamma^8 EL^{(m,lam)}[gamma^8 Psi] = -EL^{(-m,-lam)}[Psi]

lagrangian.statement: L_s[gamma^8 Psi; m, lam] = -L_s[Psi; -m, -lam] (jets of order 1-2 at the G1 points)

scalarEvenKineticOdd.statement: S even, kinetic term odd under Psi -> gamma^8 Psi

naiveFixedLambdaFails.statement: L_s[gamma^8 Psi; m, lam] + L_s[Psi; -m, lam] = -lam S^2 != 0

emt.statement: T_{mu nu}[gamma^8 Psi; -m, -lam] = -T_{mu nu}[Psi; m, lam], all 64 components (jets)

fieldEquations.statement: E_{-m,-lam}[gamma^8 Psi] = -gamma^8 E_{m,lam}[Psi] and the conjugate equation

connectionCommutes.statement: [gamma^8, Omega_mu] = 0 for the G1 connection; gamma^mu Omega_mu != 0 (curved field)

onShellImage.statement: an on-shell Psi (m, lam) has an on-shell image for (-m, -lam); the image is not a solution for (m, lam) or (-m, lam)

pairEMTAndCurrentVanish.statement: on shell: T[Psi] + T[gamma^8 Psi] = 0, j + j' = 0, L + L' = 0, S' = S

conservationBoth.statement: nabla^mu T_{mu nu} = 0 for both members of the pair (order-2 jets at p1); nonzero off shell

vielbeinSignFlipGeometry.statement: e -> -e leaves g, sqrt|g| and Omega unchanged and reverses gamma^mu

vielbeinSignFlipIsT1.statement: L_s[-e, Psi; m, lam] = -L_s[e, Psi; -m, -lam] and T likewise

gamma8WithFrameSignIsSymmetry.statement: (gamma^8, e -> -e) is an exact symmetry: L, T invariant, E[-e, gamma^8 Psi] = +gamma^8 E[e, Psi] (gamma'^mu = -gamma^mu and gamma^mu gamma^8 = -gamma^8 gamma^mu)

nontrivialCoupling.note: the individual Omega_mu depend on a4(t) (E = e^{a4}, A1 = a4'), gamma^mu Omega_mu does not

S5_T1primordial.lagrangian: L[gamma^8 Psi; m, lam] = -L[Psi; -m, -lam] in the notebook chart, generic fields of all 8 coordinates

S5_T1krein.restHamiltonians: h(m) = -i m gamma^4 (k = 0, CONTRACT section 8): Hermitian, h^2 = m^2, [h, B] = 0, gamma^8 h(m) gamma^8 = h(-m)

modes.vectors: (v+ +- i v-)/4 of Stage-4 blocks 0 and 2 (exact, orthonormal)

S5_T1krein.fieldCAR: {Psi_a, Psi^K_b} = (B P)_ab (P the projector on the four modes), {Psi_a, Psi_b} = 0: the Krein CAR {c_n, c_n^K} = beta_n realised on a positive Fock space
S5_T1krein.bilinearFromFields: sum Psi^K_a C_ab Psi_b equals the mode form sum beta_n u_n^dagger C u_m c_n^dagger c_m

expectationRule.rule: particle in mode u: <:Psi^K M Psi:> = u^dagger B M u; hole: -u^dagger B M u (normal ordering = subtraction of the sea value)

S5_T1krein.imageAnticommutatorMinusB: {Psi_-, Psi_-^K} = gamma^8 B P gamma^8 = -B P_- (P_- = gamma^8 P gamma^8): the image carries the Krein metric -B, i.e. it is canonically a field of -L_{-m,-lam}
S5_T1krein.imageOperatorIdentities: H[Psi_-; -m] = Psi_-^K B h(-m) Psi_- = -H[Psi; m], Q_- = -Q, S_- = S as Fock operators; normal ordering commutes with the map (:H_-: = -:H_+:); the image field's own generators: [Psi_-, H[Psi_-; -m]] = -h(-m) Psi_-, [Psi_-, Q[Psi_-]] = -Psi_- while i d_4 Psi_- = [Psi_-, H_+] = h(-m) Psi_-, so its x4-generator is -H[Psi_-; -m] = +H_+ and its U(1) generator -Q[Psi_-] = +Q_+ (the same quantum system as Psi in other variables)

imageExpectationValues.statement: the L_{-m,-lam} formulas H[Psi_-; -m] and Q[Psi_-] give every quantum of the image the energy -|eps| and the opposite charge; particle values u_-^dagger (-B) M u_-, u_- = gamma^8 u. These are minus the image field's own x4-generator and charge (imageOperatorIdentities), not the energy and charge of a second universe

S5_T1krein.minusMModes: w_n = gamma^8 u_n: h(-m) w_n = eps_n w_n (same eps), B w_n = -beta_n w_n
S5_T1krein.independentCARPlusB: the independently quantised -m field has {Psi', Psi'^K} = +B P_w (its own positive J = B structure)

independentExpectationValues.statement: an independently (positively) quantised -m universe: (E, Q, S) -> (E, Q, -S); its energy-momentum does NOT cancel that of the +m universe

unitVectors.statement: u = v_a gamma^a with u^2 = n(u) = +-1

untwistedAdjointIsMinusReflection.statement: u gamma^a u^{-1} = -R_u(gamma^a) (R_u the hyperplane reflection)

frameReflectionsGeometry.statement: e -> e R_u (twisted) / e -> -e R_u (untwisted): g, sqrt|g| unchanged, Omega -> u Omega u^{-1}, gamma^mu -> -+ u gamma^mu u^{-1}

scalarAndCurrentSigns.statement: kinetic term -> sK K, S -> sS S, j -> sK j with sK = -chi (twisted) / chi (untwisted), sS = chi; gamma^8 u flips sK

twistedSpacelikeMapsToMinusMSameLambda.statement: space-like u (chi = -1), twisted: L_{m,lam}[e R_u, u Psi] = L_{-m,lam}[e, Psi], T -> +T (same metric), S -> -S, j -> +j

onShellImage.statement: Psi on shell for (-m, lam) in the frame e => u Psi on shell for (m, lam) in the frame e R_u (not for (-m, lam))

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = +L_{-m,lambda}[e, Psi]
L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = +L_{-m,lambda}[e, Psi]
L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = +L_{-m,lambda}[e, Psi]
L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = +L_{-m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, u Psi] = L_{m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = -L_{-m,-lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, u Psi] = L_{m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = -L_{-m,-lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, u Psi] = L_{m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = -L_{-m,-lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, u Psi] = L_{m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = -L_{-m,-lambda}[e, Psi]
L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = +L_{-m,lambda}[e, Psi]
L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = +L_{-m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, u Psi] = L_{m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = -L_{-m,-lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, u Psi] = L_{m,lambda}[e, Psi]

untwisted_gamma8u.result: L_{m,lambda}[-e R_u, gamma^8 u Psi] = -L_{-m,-lambda}[e, Psi]

geometry.statement: h_mu(y) = h_mu(-y) (W = e^{-H|y|} even): y -> -y is an isometry; Omega^+_mu(y) = gamma^0 Omega^-_mu(-y) gamma^0 (the frame reflection of e_0); gamma^mu Omega_mu = -3H gamma^0 (y > 0) and +3H gamma^0 (y < 0); vielbein postulate on both patches

S5_T2z2.diracOperator: gamma^mu D_mu Psi'(y) = -gamma^0 (gamma^mu D_mu Psi)(-y) for Psi'(y) = gamma^0 Psi(-y) (all 9 data components, both patches)
S5_T2z2.lagrangianEven: L_{-m,lam}[Psi'](y) = L_{m,lam}[Psi](-y) with the quartic term; sqrt|g| = W^6 is even
S5_T2z2.fieldEquationMapsToMinusMSameLambda: E_{-m,lam}[Psi'](y) = -gamma^0 E_{m,lam}[Psi](-y) (with the cubic term): Psi solves (m, lam) on y < 0 iff Psi' solves (-m, lam) on y > 0 (the SAME lambda)
S5_T2z2.sameMassFails: with the same mass: E_{m,lam}[Psi'](y) + gamma^0 E_{m,lam}[Psi](-y) = -2m gamma^0 Psi(-y) != 0
S5_T2z2.massFunctionMap: for a mass function m(y): E_{m(y)}[Psi'](y) = -gamma^0 E_{-m(y)}[Psi](-y): the image solves the equation with the mass function y -> -m(-y)
S5_T2z2.symmetricIffOddMass: a Z2-symmetric configuration Psi(y) = gamma^0 Psi(-y) solves the equations on both sides with ONE mass function m iff (m(y) + m(-y)) Psi(-y) = 0, i.e. iff m is odd where Psi != 0: the -M mirror universe

emtPullback.statement: T'_{mu nu}(y) = s_mu s_nu T_{mu nu}(-y), s = (-1, 1, ..., 1) (order y, x1..x7) for Psi' with (-m, lam): kinetic parts pulled back, L_s even, S odd, g_{mu nu} even: the EMT of the mirror universe is the pull-back (same energy density and pressures)

S5_T2z2.currentPullback: j'^mu(y) = s_mu j^mu(-y): the charge density j^4 is even
S5_T2z2.PBfieldLevelFlipsLambda: P_B: Psi'(y) = i gamma^0 gamma^8 Psi(-y): D Psi' = P_B (D Psi)(-y), S -> -S, K -> -K, hence E_{m,-lam}[Psi'](y) = P_B E_{m,lam}[Psi](-y) and L_{m,-lam}[Psi'](y) = -L_{m,lam}[Psi](-y)

ruleParities.note: expectation-rule matrices n = B B, s = BC, t = -gamma^4 gamma^1, c = gamma^0 gamma^4: the rule matrix BC is P_B-even while C is P_B-odd

S5_T2z2.PBRuleMatrixEvenCOdd: P_B BC P_B = BC, P_B C P_B = -C: P_B is a same-lambda symmetry only at the mean-field level with the expectation rule, not at the field level

gamma8IsSigma2BetweenPartnerBlocks.statement: V^dagger gamma^8 V maps block (j, s2, s3) onto (-j, s2, s3) as c sigma2 (|c| = 1)

S5_T3block.gamma0IsSigma3: gamma^0 = sigma3 in every block (block diagonal)

blockODEMaps.N_j(M, k): M sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (eps - v_v) sigma1
blockODEMaps.sigma2: sigma2 N_j(M, k) sigma2 = N_{-j}(-M, k)
blockODEMaps.sigma3: -sigma3 N_j(M, k) sigma3 = N_j(-M, k) (with y -> -y)

S5_T3block.sixteenComponentODEMaps: gamma^8 N(M, k) gamma^8 = N(-M, k), gamma^1 N(M, k) gamma^1 = N(-M, -k), N = M gamma^0 - i kappa k gamma^0 gamma^1 + i (eps - v_v) gamma^0 gamma^4
S5_T3block.hamiltonianMaps: sigma2 h_j(M, k) = h_{-j}(-M, k) sigma2 and sigma1 h_j(M, k) = h_j(-M, -k) sigma1 as differential operators, v_v unchanged (h_j = j[-i sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v_v)
S5_T3block.parityMap: even parity chi_2(0) = 0 <-> odd parity chi_1(0) = 0 under sigma2 and sigma1 (p -> -p); unchanged under sigma3

bagAngleMap.stage4Default: theta = 0 (chi_2(-L) = 0) -> theta = pi (chi_1(-L) = 0) under sigma2 and sigma1
bagAngleMap.asymptoticBag: theta(k) = -sgn(k) pi/2 is mapped onto itself (sigma2: same k; sigma1: k -> -k)

S5_T3block.sigma2IsRustSwap: chi = (a, i b): sigma2 (a, i b) = (b, i a), the component swap a <-> b

densityAndCurrentMaps.densities: n = chi^dagger chi, s = j chi^dagger sigma2 chi, t = j chi^dagger sigma3 chi, c = j chi^dagger sigma1 chi
densityAndCurrentMaps.imageRule: with the Krein metric -B of the gamma^8 image every one-body density flips in addition: sigma2 route (n, s, t, c) -> (-n, s, -t, -c)

S5_T3block.densityMaps16: on 16-component orbitals of the Stage-4 blocks: u -> gamma^8 u gives (n, s, t, c) -> (n, -s, t, c) with the standard rule and (-n, s, -t, -c) with the image rule

potentialsStandardRule.map: (m, lam, n, S) -> (-m, lam, n, -S): M_eff -> -M_eff, v_s -> -v_s, v_v -> v_v, e_H + e_x invariant
potentialsStandardRule.withMinusLambda: M_eff(-m, -lam, n, -S) + M_eff = 2 lam S (1 + sg/16) != 0: fails for lam S != 0

S5_T3block.potentialsImageRule: (m, lam, n, S) -> (-m, -lam, -n, S): M_eff -> -M_eff, v_v -> v_v, e_H + e_x -> -(e_H + e_x)

S5_T3ks.stationarityBothStatistics: d e / d chi_i^* = f_i h_KS chi_i with h_KS = j[-i sigma1 d_y + M_eff sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v_v, M_eff = m + lam S_p + v_s, v_s = sg (lam/16) S_p, v_v = sg (lam/16) n_p (sg symbolic: both statistics)
S5_T3ks.sigma2FunctionalInvariant: E[sigma2 chi; j -> -j, -m, lam] = E[chi; j, m, lam] for sg = +-1 (entropy terms depend on f only)

sigma2KSOperatorEquivariant.statement: sigma2 h_KS,j[m, lam; n, S] = h_KS,-j[-m, lam; n, -S] sigma2: the SCF map is equivariant
sigma2KSOperatorEquivariant.negativeControl: the ordinary KS problem with -lam (and the mapped densities) does NOT map

S5_T3ks.sigma1FunctionalInvariant: sigma1 route (gamma^1: same j, k -> -k): E[sigma1 chi; -m, -k] = E[chi; m, k] (closed shells {k, -k})
S5_T3ks.imageRuleEnergyOdd: Krein image (metric -B, -lam): n -> -n, S -> S, E -> -E (the (-m, -lam) formulas evaluated on the image, T1krein), and the image orbitals sigma2 chi solve the KS equations of (-m, -lam) with the image densities
S5_T3ks.occupationsAndTemperature: f_FD(eps; mu, T) = f_FD(-eps; -mu, -T); the Mermin stationarity eps - mu + T ln(f/(1-f)) = 0 maps onto itself for (-eps, -mu, -T): the image is a stationary state of F_- at temperature -T, F_-(-T) = -F_+(T)
S5_T3ks.zeroModePlusM: +M, even parity chi_2(0) = 0, bag theta = 0 (chi_2(-L) = 0): chi = (e^{My}, 0), eps = 0
S5_T3ks.zeroModeImage: image sigma2 chi = (0, i e^{My}) solves the -M block (-j) with chi_1 = 0 at y = 0 and y = -L (odd parity, theta = pi)

zeroModeUntransformedControl.statement: -M with the untransformed BCs (even parity, theta = 0): chi = (e^{-My}, 0), eps = 0, localised at the tip

zeroModeSplittingMapsExactly.note: d eps/dk|_0 = j c(M) for +M (block j) and for the image (block -j, sigma3 = -1)

S5_T3ks.massiveLevelsMap: eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/L)^2): the +M even/theta = 0 orbital maps onto a -M odd/theta = pi orbital at the same eps (these levels coincide also for the untransformed control)

mixedSectorSolutions.+M: odd parity chi_1(0) = 0, theta = 0: eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + q^2), q cos(qL) + M sin(qL) = 0
mixedSectorSolutions.control: -M, same BCs: q cos(qL) - M sin(qL) = 0
mixedSectorSolutions.transformed: -M, even parity with theta = pi (the image): the same condition as +M

S5_T3ks.controlMixedSectorLevelsDisjoint: q cos qL + M sin qL = 0 and q cos qL - M sin qL = 0 have no common solution (sin^2 + cos^2 = 1, M, q > 0)

controlSubGapBoundState.statement: control (-M, odd parity, theta = 0): chi = (sinh(ky), ...), |eps| = sqrt(M^2 - k^2) < M with tanh(kL) = k/M: a root k in (0, M) iff ML > 1; +M: k cosh kL + M sinh kL > 0, no bound state

gamma8OperatorIdentity64.statement: gamma^8 X_{mu nu}(-m, -M_eff) gamma^8 = -X_{mu nu}(m, M_eff)

S5_T3emt.standardRulePlusT: (gamma^8 chi)^dagger B X(-m, -M_eff) (gamma^8 chi) = chi^dagger B X(m, M_eff) chi: T -> +T (gamma^8 B gamma^8 = -B)
S5_T3emt.imageRuleMinusT: with the Krein metric -B of the image: T -> -T (the (-m, -lam) formula; relative to the image's own canonical structure its source is +T, T1krein)

stage4CrossCheck.statement: reduced to the Stage-4 blocks the kernels give rho = (eps - v_v) n - (M_eff - m) s, p_y = eps n - m s - kappa k t, p_1 = v_v n + (M_eff - m) s + kappa k t, p_2 = p_3 = p_t = v_v n + (M_eff - m) s (per e^{-6Hy}/l^3; STAGE4 emt family)

S5_T3emt.orbitalFormulasMap: the per-orbital rho, p_y, p_(i) are invariant under the standard-rule map and change sign under the image rule; the interaction part e_H + e_x is invariant (standard) / odd (image, -lam), so the KS-state EMT maps the same way
S5_T3emt.connectionClosedForms: own spin connection: Omega_i = -W' e^{a4} S^{0i} (i = 1..3), Omega_j = +W' e^{-a4} S^{0j} (j = 5..7), Omega_y = Omega_4 = 0 (the Stage-4 closed forms)

S5_stat.testUnitaries: three exact unitaries (identity and two Cayley transforms of anti-Hermitian Gaussian-integer matrices) and Hermitian A, B with Gaussian-integer entries
S5_stat.fermionQuasiFreeStates: D = prod_n [(1 - f_n) c c^+ + f_n c^+ c]: Tr D = 1, <psi^+ A psi> = Tr(A rho), rho = U diag(f) U^+ (pure Slater determinants and mixed states)

fermionWickMinus.statement: <:(psi^+ A psi)(psi^+ B psi):> = Tr(A rho) Tr(B rho) - Tr(A rho B rho); the full product adds Tr(A B rho) (12 states: 3 bases x 4 occupation sets)

S5_stat.singleModeMoments: geometric (thermal) number distribution (1 - q) q^k, q = f/(1 + f): <k> = f, <k^2> = f + 2 f^2 (exact series)
S5_stat.bosonThermalWickPlus: bosonic thermal quasi-free states (symbolic occupations f0, f1, f2, a rational unitary basis change): <:(psi^+ A psi)(psi^+ B psi):> = Tr(A rho) Tr(B rho) + Tr(A rho B rho); full product + Tr(A B rho)
S5_stat.classicalGaussianWickPlus: circular Gaussian ensemble, density (1/(pi f)) e^{-|c|^2/f} per mode: <c-bar^a c^b> = delta_ab a! f^a (exact integrals); <(psi^* A psi)(psi^* B psi)> = Tr(A rho) Tr(B rho) + Tr(A rho B rho), no Tr(A B rho) term
S5_stat.fixedAmplitudePhasesDeviate: random phases with FIXED amplitudes |c_n|^2 = f_n: the Gaussian result minus sum_n f_n^2 (U^+AU)_nn (U^+BU)_nn
S5_stat.expectationRuleTraces: with the two-point function G = rho B of the rule: Tr(C G) = Tr(BC rho), Tr(C G C G) = Tr(BC rho BC rho); hence E_HF = (lam/2)[Tr(BC rho)^2 + sg Tr(BC rho BC rho)], sg = -1 (anticommuting), +1 (commuting)

expectationRuleKreinFock.statement: anticommuting Krein-Fock field on 4 moving-shell modes (m = 7, p = 24, E = 25) with BOTH Krein signs: <:S^2:> = Tr(BC rho)^2 - Tr(BC rho BC rho), <S> = Tr(BC rho)

filledShellExchangeRatio.statement: E_x = sg (lam/2) Tr(BC P BC P) = sg E_H / 8: -E_H/8 (dirac16complex), +E_H/8 (dirac16complex00)

uniformGasExactFinite.gas: m = 2, 11 momenta closed under p -> -p on the shells E = 2, 3, 4, 5 (exact), arbitrary isotropic occupations f_+(E), f_-(E); rho = sum [f_+ P_+(p) - f_- P_-(p)] (holes of the sea)
uniformGasExactFinite.statement: Tr(BC rho BC rho) = (n^2 + S^2)/16 exactly: e_x = sg (lam/32)(n^2 + S^2) for both statistics

uniformGasExchange.kernel: Tr(P_a(p) BC P_b(q) BC) = 4[1 + a b (m^2 - p.q)/(E_p E_q)] (exact trace table)
uniformGasExchange.gas: rho = int [f_+ P_+ - f_- P_-]: Tr(BC rho BC rho) = 4[(I0+ - I0-)^2 + (I1+ + I1-)^2] - 4 |J|^2 with I0 = int f, I1 = int f m/E, J = int (f_+ + f_-) p/E... = 0 for any occupation even under p -> -p
uniformGasExchange.result: e_x = sg (lam/2) Tr(BC rho BC rho) = sg (lam/32)(n^2 + S^2) for every T: -(lam/32)(n^2 + S^2) (dirac16complex), +(lam/32)(n^2 + S^2) (dirac16complex00)

ldaPotentials.note: M_eff = m + (15/16) lam S_p resp. m + (17/16) lam S_p; v_x = v_v

T0TotalDerivative.statement: at T = 0 along the gas: de_x/dn = sg (lam/16)[n + S m/E_F] (d = 3 and 4)

expectationRuleCovarianceIndefinite.consequence: K is indefinite: the dirac16complex00 KS model with the expectation rule is a formal (Krein-signed) Gaussian functional, not a probability ensemble of classical fields; with the positive covariance K = rho a filled shell has Tr(B P_+) = Tr(C P_+) = 0 (zero charge, zero scalar density) at rest and at the moving point m = 2, p = (0,1,2,4)

fieldLevelChiralPair.field: Stage-2 primordial field (notebook chart, arbitrary a4(t), generic point)
fieldLevelChiralPair.totals: T = 0 (64 components), j = 0, L = 0, S = 2 S
fieldLevelChiralPair.meaning: the chiral {+M, -M} pair carries no energy-momentum, no charge and no action, at every x4

fieldLevelMirrorPair.pair: {(m, lam, e, Psi), (-m, lam, e R_u, u Psi)}, u = gamma^1 (space-like, chi = -1), G1 field at p2
fieldLevelMirrorPair.totals: T = 2T, j = 2j, L = 2L, S = 0: the mirror pair doubles the energy-momentum

ksMirrorPair.orbital: +M: chi = ((M sin qy + q cos qy)/(i eps), sin qy), q = n pi/L, block j = +1 (even parity, theta = 0); -M: sigma2 chi in block j = -1 (odd parity, theta = pi), the same eps
ksMirrorPair.totals: n_pair = 2n, S_pair = 0, rho, p_y, p_(i) doubled (standard rule); E_pair = 2E (same spectrum)

ksKreinImagePair.totals: Krein image (metric -B, -lam): n_pair = 0 (charge 0), rho_pair = p_pair = 0 pointwise, S_pair = 2 S_+
ksKreinImagePair.note: the image values are the negatives of the standard-rule values of the mapped orbital: the totals are the identity X + (-X) = 0 for one state in two sets of variables (T1krein), not a cancellation between two universes
